title: Zesty Molten Turkish Eggs Menemen
description: A kid-friendly Turkish dish featuring mint and long-fermentation-dough, this menemen is a halal-friendly option for breakfast, made with umami and molten ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the long-fermentation-dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Cut out 4 equal-sized squares from the dough.
In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped mint leaves to the egg mixture and stir well.
Place a tablespoon of butter on each dough square, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Spoon the egg mixture over the butter on each dough square.
Fold the dough squares in half to enclose the egg mixture, pressing the edges to seal.
Place the menemen on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each.
Bake the menemen in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until the dough is golden brown and the eggs are set.
